tools.name: inspect_security_and_hallucinations
tools.description: Comprehensive security and NLI hallucination inspection for agent outputs against ground truth context with EIP-191 cryptographic attestation.

agent_output.description: The raw output or response generated by an autonomous LLM agent.

context_ground_truth.description: The trusted ground truth context or source documents to verify faithfulness against.

caller_id.description: Optional agent caller identifier or wallet address for tracking.

tools.name: verify_agent_output
tools.description: High-speed (<5ms) deterministic prompt injection, jailbreak, and secret leak scanner for autonomous agent actions.

text.description: The text content to inspect for malicious prompt injections or secret leaks.

tools.name: inspect_code_ast_safety
tools.description: Deterministic Python AST parser scanning for hazardous calls (subprocess, os.system, eval, exec, socket, token leakage).

code.description: The Python source code snippet to parse and audit via AST.

tools.name: get_onchain_security_attestation
tools.description: Generate EIP-712 cryptographic signatures and Solidity calldata (v, r, s) for smart contract-level on-chain agent guardrails.

action_payload.description: The raw action payload, transaction data, or agent decision string to attest.

risk_score_max.description: Maximum acceptable risk score threshold (0.0 to 1.0).
